question: Should this issue remain the umbrella tracker for a unified memory-management contract, or should maintainers narrow it to one specific config/API contract after reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, migration behavior, and memory lifecycle semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/API direction.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush/write behavior, and operator memory surfaces converge.

options.title: Narrow To Memory Modes
options.body: Reduce this issue to a specific builtin-only/qmd-only/mixed or equivalent mode contract once the role-slot PR direction is decided.

options.title: Delegate To Linked Tracks
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only if maintainers decide the open role-slot, Memory MVP, and bounded-memory issues fully own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush/write behavior, and operator memory surfaces converge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a durable public config/plugin API direction choice, and steipete is the official project decision owner in CONTRIBUTING.md.
